name: Ali Taj
office: City of Artesia, Member of the City Council

items.text: Ali Taj is a member of the Artesia City Council and has served as mayor. Before entering office, he worked in the financial services industry, including as a vice president at American Express. He served as president of the League of California Cities. His 2026 campaign questionnaire says he supported Measure AAA, a 2024 ballot measure to fund public safety programs. In that questionnaire, he also said he chairs the Eco-Rapid Transit Authority. He says he worked to make Artesia a starting point for the Southeast Gateway Line light rail to downtown Los Angeles. He has praised state legislation addressing climate change and energy affordability.
